cycle.text: In a championship interview: wheels on the intake guide balls to the middle, and a ramp conveyor pushes a ball up and holds it until the shot. The flywheel runs all match, its speed following the distance the Limelight sees; dark blue LEDs mean lined up.

endgame.text: A powered hook takes the mid rung and pulls up until other hooks snap on; those deploy so the powered hook can reach the next rung, and the sequence repeats. About 15 to 20 s to traversal.
Forum posts say it was undefeated at the Great Northern Regional without climbing in qualification, for unstated reasons, though able to.

changed.text: The first climber had narrower hooks and a single hook on one part. At the second regional a four-stage, two-arm climber was really fast but had mechanical issues. The team then returned to the first, with wider hooks that clear the turret and two hooks for less swinging.

outcome.text: 36-7-0 in official play; ranked 6 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 64.65, Turing).

solves.text: Go in any direction and rotate

cost.text: The driver says it takes time and a lot of practice to learn

facts.text: The team's first year of swerve, after tank drives
One joystick moves the robot and the other rotates it

solves.text: Bring balls over the bumper and toward the middle of the robot

facts.text: A Lexan guard drops down when the intake first deploys, and helps balls over the bumper into the chute
Custom foam roller with a carbon fiber rod inside
3D printed mecanum wheels, with larger ones at the ends to guide balls to the middle
It is compliant: with balls against a wall it bounces back in, which helps protect it
